author: Mysterio
title: The Definitive Pizza Ranking
content: I have seen the future, and it contains the greatest pizza ever created. Perfect crust, perfect cheese, perfect toppings. Spider-Man claims his favorite is better, but I have created an illusion where he admits I am correct. The illusion is extremely convincing. Biiith

author: Spider-Man
title: Okay, Mysterio Is Wrong About Pizza
content: For the record, I never admitted Mysterio was right about anything. Especially pizza. You cannot just make a giant holographic pizza and call it the best pizza in New York. Also, pineapple belongs on pizza. There, I said it.

author: Iron Man
title: Mysterio Has a Point
content: I hate to say it, kid, but Mysterio's pizza argument has some merit. The man showed up with a twenty-foot holographic pizza and somehow made it look delicious. Meanwhile, Peter once burned a frozen pizza. I have security footage.

author: Captain America
title: We Need to Settle This Properly
content: I think we should settle this the traditional way: everyone gets a slice and we vote. Mysterio has already prepared twelve pizzas, three of which are apparently illusions. I'm not sure which ones are real, but honestly they all smell pretty good.

author: Thor
title: Mysterio's Pizza Is Worthy
content: I have eaten pizza in many realms, and Mysterio's pizza is powerful indeed. The cheese stretches farther than the Bifrost. Spider-Man's pizza was acceptable, although he became strangely upset when I called his crust 'mortal.'

author: Black Widow
title: Peter Is Taking This Too Seriously
content: I've watched Spider-Man fight supervillains with less arguing than he's doing over pizza. Mysterio has a point. His pizza is good. We should probably stop encouraging this before someone brings up New York versus Chicago style.

author: Hulk
title: Hulk Likes Mysterio Pizza
content: HULK LIKE GREEN PIZZA. MYSTERIO MAKE PIZZA LOOK BIG. SPIDER-MAN SAY PIZZA TOO BIG. HULK SAY SPIDER-MAN WRONG. HULK ALSO EAT SPIDER-MAN'S PIZZA. HULK SORRY.

author: Spider-Man
title: This Is Getting Ridiculous
content: Okay, everyone has officially lost the plot. Thor thinks pizza can be worthy, Hulk ate my entire slice, and Tony is using security footage to win an argument about food. Mysterio, congratulations. You somehow turned a pizza debate into a superhero civil war.
